title: Imperial Star Destroyer — Devastator
description: A grand Imperial dagger with continuous diagonal armor, recessed equatorial machinery, eight twin turbolaser batteries, layered command decks, a hammerhead bridge with paired shield generators, an open ventral docking aperture and seven deep axial engine bells. Compact black cradles leave the ship's silhouette unobstructed.
